title: Cache the usage sweep's per-file counts so a launch rereads only changed session logs
notes: From the Rust review (/tmp/rust-review.md section 4) and docs/performance/history.md:181-207. The usage sweep (src/main/usage/usage-store.ts) rereads about 4.6 GB of session logs on every launch: 14-17 CPU-seconds on its worker thread. history.md:205 already names the fix: save per-file counts in userData, keyed by path, size and mtime, and reread only a file that changed or is new (an appended log rereads from where it left off, or whole if simpler). Totals must equal the uncached sweep's: a test comparing the two on a fixture folder. Record the before/after launch CPU in history.md.
